item.title: Chicago Bulls edge Phoenix Suns 105-103 behind Collin Sexton’s season-high 30 points in opener of 5-game trip
item.description: Collin Sexton scored a season-high 30 points and the Chicago Bulls held off the Phoenix Suns 105-103 on Thursday night for their second win in three games following an 11-game skid.

item.title: Answer Angel: Olympics style question
item.description: Dear Answer Angel Ellen: I was enthralled with the Olympic ice skating competition. I couldn’t get enough of it! The performance of women’s free style gold medalist Alysa Liu was — of course — spellbinding!

item.title: The Kid Whisperer: How to make sure you are not raising a manipulative jerk
item.description: Dear Kid Whisperer, My 9-year-old wants a dog. She started making simple requests for a dog. That led to loud requests, then screaming, and now she throws huge tantrums.

item.title: Asking Eric: They are rude and condescending toward me
item.description: Dear Eric: My husband has two sisters. One sister's adult son and daughter have always been mean to me. It started when the niece and my son by my first marriage dated about five times. She talks negatively about everyone and everything.
